title: Fix uipcodedappdeploy v2.1 self-invalidating version stage
description: Execution currently mutates tracked pyproject.toml before _validate_source(), so every approved plan whose planned version differs from source fails its own clean-source gate. Reorder or narrowly validate the exact planned version mutation without weakening source/digest binding.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test exercises the real execute ordering without mocking _validate_source; unrelated tracked or untracked source drift still fails; exact planned pyproject version succeeds; plan and receipt hashes remain bound; full uipcodedappdeploy test/validation suite passes; installed skill parity is restored.
notes:
Implemented fail-closed source validation and remediated both independent-review blockers. Execution now checks exact HEAD, exact index-to-HEAD parity, and rejects assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, sparse, unmerged, or other hidden index state. It independently verifies every HEAD-tracked path type, Git executable mode, and content using HEAD attributes; recursively verifies submodules; and forces status inspection with ignore-submodules=none plus NUL-delimited porcelain parsing. Version-stage allowances are plan/stage-bound: pyproject.toml and, when uv.lock exists, a deterministic local-project-version-only uv.lock transition are separately hashed in initial/versioned input snapshots. Resume recognizes the plan-derived post-version/pre-lock state without allowing unrelated drift. Real temporary-Git regressions do not mock _validate_source and cover explicit version success, tracked build drift, newline untracked paths, assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, submodule ignore=all, arbitrary rehashed lock transition rejection, actual uv lock success, and lock-stage resume. Final verification: focused uipcodedappdeploy 58/58; repository make validate Green, including Beads history, 12 skills/275 text files, all Python suites, Node 470/470, and diff-check; secret scan Green. Installed-skill parity remains intentionally pending per release-owner instruction, so this issue stays in progress.
Independent re-review exposed a remaining Git clean-filter bypass: status and hash-object --path could both be clean while raw worktree bytes differed. Superseded plan/receipt contracts with incompatible schema 2.2 and raw-tracked-worktree-v1. Plans now bind raw regular bytes, Git modes, symlink targets, and recursively checked-out submodules for initial, version_written, and versioned states; execution compares the exact raw stage digest in addition to existing Git object/status checks. Added a real .gitattributes filter=mask regression with git-add/index parity and empty status that fails before version write, plus an unchanged filtered/smudged worktree success case. v2.1 plans/receipts are explicitly rejected and must be regenerated without migration. Verification: focused uipcodedappdeploy 61/61 Green; full uv-isolated make validate Green (12 skills/275 text files, all Python suites, Node 470/470, diff-check); secret scan Green. Installed-skill parity remains pending after PR review/merge, so issue stays in progress.

The implementer changed verification to reject every redirect away from the exact approved URL and added a cross-host regression test; re-review confirms the defect is resolved. No unresolved P0-P3 findings remain. Contract review confirms explicit staging or alpha is required for executable plans; staging and alpha map only to their exact control-plane origins and verification-host suffixes; production, implicit, missing-pair, cross-environment, port-bearing, credentialed, bare-suffix, and query-bearing targets fail closed. Environment is bound into the full plan hash, CLI profile hash, deployment-binding hash, plan revalidation, receipt hash and receipt-to-plan validation. Existing exact plan-hash approval, source/dist/CLI/profile/client/candidate-package checks, byte recheck before publish, and indeterminate external-write resume denial remain intact. Evidence: focused unittest suite 49/49 Green after remediation; both v2.1 JSON schema files parse; git diff --check Green; full uv-isolated Python 3.12 make validate Green, including 105 Beads transitions, 12 skills and 275 text files, all Python suites, Node tests, syntax, and diff gates. title: Publish Beads lifecycle history for collaborators
description:
## Problem
The repository currently commits only the latest .beads/issues.jsonl snapshot. Full lifecycle history remains in the local embedded Dolt database and is not transparent to GitHub collaborators.

## Required change
Add a supported, deterministic, Git-tracked audit-history artifact and collaborator workflow that preserves issue state transitions without committing machine-local Dolt internals.

## Verification
Prove a fresh clone can inspect the current issues and their published lifecycle history; validate generated artifacts for secrets, local paths, deterministic ordering, and repository compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub contains current Beads state plus reviewable lifecycle history; generation is reproducible and validated; collaborator instructions explain refresh and recovery; a fresh-clone verification passes; PR checks pass.
notes:
Subagent research and audit findings:
- Beads 1.0.3 supports full-history publication to the same GitHub repository through refs/dolt/data. Fresh clones discover that ref with bd bootstrap --yes before falling back to issues.jsonl. The supported push path is an explicit Dolt remote and bd dolt push; force pushes must be prohibited.
- Fresh-clone audit proved issues.jsonl alone restores current fields, labels, notes, and dependencies but collapses skills-ra5 from 17 native history rows to one imported snapshot and skills-nnz from 12 rows to one. Plain bd init is destructive here: it created an empty DB and deleted the tracked snapshot. Safe setup is chmod 700 .beads, bd bootstrap --yes, git config beads.role maintainer, and bd hooks install --beads.
- bd history is only an issue-table projection: it repeats unchanged rows and omits label, dependency, comment, external-ref, and started-at history. interactions.jsonl and the unimplemented bd export --events path are not valid substitutes. Therefore the design must pair the native Dolt ref with an explicitly limited, deduplicated Git-review projection.
- Transparency and privacy review found zero known secret or local-path pattern matches in the current native issue, event, dependency, comment, and Dolt-log data. Native data intentionally includes Keith Born and keith.born@uipath.com; Dolt root attribution is not useful and is excluded from the projection. All Beads values must be treated as public.
- Hardening recommendation adopted: deterministic history.jsonl, a manifest anchoring artifact hashes to Dolt HEAD, offline terminal-state and append-only validation, recursive decoded-JSON leak scanning, safe bootstrap docs, and fresh-clone recovery proof.
Integration and verification evidence:
- Published native Dolt history to GitHub refs/dolt/data without force and verified the ref from both HTTPS and SSH Git remotes.
- Published 17 deduplicated issue-state transitions plus a SHA-256 manifest anchored to Dolt HEAD clvcd0hueuc5de6v97c2mi75hjm70hvv.
- Scanned 683 historical rows across issues, events, dependencies, comments, labels, config, metadata, interactions, and Dolt log records; found zero known secret or local-path pattern matches.
- Repeated export under TZ=UTC and LC_ALL=C produced identical issues, history, and manifest hashes.
- Full local validation passed: 11 skills, all Python suites, 162 Node tests, whitespace checks, and secret scan across 212 Git-visible text files.
- Cold clone bootstrap dry-run selected sync.remote and cloned from the GitHub Dolt ref, not issues.jsonl. The recovered native head matched the manifest; bd history returned 18 rows for skills-ra5, 13 for skills-nnz, and 3 for skills-ts6; both dependency links, notes, and labels survived.
- Fresh-clone current-state export was byte-identical, hooks installed successfully, metadata and secret validation passed, and Git remained clean.
- Draft PR 4 commit d6b9de6 passed both push and pull-request GitHub Validate runs.
close_reason: Native Beads history, review projection, manifest, safe collaborator workflow, fresh-clone recovery, and GitHub checks are verified.

title: Exclude Beads runtime state from repository validation
description:
## Problem
The repository metadata validator traverses ignored .beads/embeddeddolt files. Beads stores machine-local paths there by design, so make validate fails immediately after a standard initialization.

## Required change
Keep validating tracked Beads configuration and exported issue history, but exclude untracked/local Beads runtime and backup directories from repository-wide source scans.

## Verification
Run the full make validate and make secrets gates with Beads initialized.
acceptance_criteria: The validator ignores local Beads runtime artifacts without broadly exempting tracked Beads configuration; make validate and make secrets both pass.
notes: Root cause: text_files() recursively scanned ignored local runtime artifacts. Fix: enumerate Git tracked plus untracked non-ignored files when the validation root is a Git worktree, with the existing recursive fallback for non-Git test fixtures. Added a regression test proving ignored .beads/embeddeddolt state is excluded while non-ignored .beads/config.yaml remains validated. Verified with make validate and make secrets using isolated Python 3.12 plus pinned requirements: 11 skills validated, all Python suites passed, 162 Node tests passed, diff checks passed, and the secret scan passed for 208 candidate files.
close_reason: Validator boundary fixed and full repository gates passed.

title: Initialize Beads for development history
description:
## Context
This repository needs durable, dependency-aware progress and historical tracking for development and build work.

## Work
Initialize Beads with a repository-local Dolt database, tracked JSONL export, Git hooks, and agent workflow instructions.

## Verification
Confirm the database opens, hooks are installed, issue history is queryable, and the ready queue works.
acceptance_criteria: Embedded Dolt opens and reports the skills database; the skills- prefix is active; repository hooks are executable; issue lifecycle history is queryable; Codex integration is current; embedded-versus-shared persistence is documented; ready/list commands work; and .beads/issues.jsonl exports durable shared tracker state.
notes:
Verified embedded Dolt status and configuration, a two-entry issue history (open to in_progress), executable Git hooks, bd ready/list/stats behavior, and tracked JSONL export. bd doctor and bd dolt test explicitly report that they are unsupported in embedded mode; this is a CLI limitation, not a failed health check.
Post-close repository validation found a blocker: tools/validate_repo.py scans .beads/embeddeddolt runtime state and reports its expected local data path as an absolute-path leak. Reopened until the validator excludes local Beads runtime artifacts and the full gate passes.
Pre-publication integration check reported the Codex AGENTS.md recipe as stale. Reopened to refresh the supported Codex integration before publishing.
Refreshed the supported Codex recipe and verified both Codex and Claude integrations report current. Documented the actual persistence model: full lifecycle history is local embedded Dolt, no Dolt remote is configured, and Git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl is the shared cross-clone snapshot. Removed misleading generic file-deletion guidance from the AGENTS.md preamble.
Published as draft GitHub PR #4 on branch codex/initialize-beads. Both initial GitHub Validate workflow runs passed.
close_reason: Beads initialization, Codex integration, persistence documentation, regression fix, and repository validation are complete.
